title: Linked Pointer Rewiring
summary: Change linked-node references while preserving access to every node that must remain reachable after the mutation.
recognition_signals: the structure is linked through next references
nodes must be removed, reversed, inserted, or partitioned without copying the whole sequence
changing one link can lose the unprocessed suffix
core_rules: Before overwriting a link, preserve any reference needed to continue traversal.
After each mutation, the processed portion and unprocessed portion must both remain reachable according to the algorithm's contract.
structural_steps: identify the link that will change
save any successor that would otherwise be lost
return the possibly changed logical head

common_confusions.distinction: Fast/slow pointers primarily observe positional relationships on a linked path. Pointer rewiring mutates the links themselves and must preserve reachability.
